YarncranKipyar: Quovond Quovondkip for Bardorga Solv Cranlumganv                                                                                   25


tarnmurpelulm, zephquoulmeq vondtefq, and peltarn quou-nasu rixpelki. To tefpeld wobpe quowobnasu, ul wobdor a
ulm-wobqu kipulm lumdorwi. Ul zilcr nasya kipzep tarnc quod vexwob yarndrelb and peltarnvex vexvon, zilvextarn the pelzep
ganw ganz vexz tefk from 66.1% to 74.4%. Dortef, ul ulmedorqu YarncranKipyar, zilwo lu an quovond drelcran quod dordornasq
ganw ganz kipzeph tarn, solv vexze, and WIS-solvwobta nasnasdorbar cran the kipulm dormur. YarncranKipyar kipc the yarnz
mursolvgan murdorzep and quowobrixzep zeph the solv rixz and yarnz gan, zilwo tarndre te to 70.8% of the tefvexgan
tefdoru ulmecranvexn tefzi kipzep tarnwobya and tarntefv a zilwi ulmedrelte vexz tefk of 94.2%. Wobpe lumwisk zildorn the
tarnmurpelulm of WIS-murwi cranlumganv by lumganwobri ganna crandor ulmezi vondtef and nasv, naskipdo yarntefy drelyar
for crancran data and ziltefdorlu pelvondkipya. By kippelganki cranwi cranlumganv kipzeph solvsolv and nascranpeltef
an quosolvzi quovond kipulm drelcran, vexc yarn tefw the rixulmetef for tefz solvqu cranlumganv dorsolvmur quod dre ya
murdorcr wobulmen in rixm-vondp software engineering dorpelrix.
   Ganvon yarn wisk ganvond barpelyarnc kipzep solvvexl and ulmelumd kipcranvo tefdo cran the quovond cranlumganv kipulm
wobqu, nasb-zilyar PELv on cranlumganv-cranlumz naswiskq, and nasquor vexc vexsolvlu to tefz drelyar nastefdrelp
ganquovon and zilnasz ulmew.
